plan_title: SSPLAN-623 Test Plan — Show Weekly Sales vs Latest Financial Forecast

results.steps: Open SalesByWeek route with valid country context and data.
results.assertion: Chart region, title, toggles, and CY/LY series render with no runtime errors.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. results.assertion: Forecast line and legend item are visible only in QTY view with non-null data points.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open the weekly chart routes from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm switching the metric to QTY shows forecast while non-QTY views hide it. results.steps: Return empty array from weekly metric response.
results.assertion: Empty-state UX shown; no broken layout or crash.
results.evidence: The empty-state path is stable: when no weekly data exists, `SalesIndexChart` renders a placeholder instead of chart markup (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/SalesIndexChart.tsx:19-23,82-83,116-123,153-158).

results.assertion: Error message/retry path is visible and route remains stable.
results.evidence: Callers catch weekly metric failures and fall back without crashing the page (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), but the chart does not present a user-visible retry/error state matching the plan.

results.steps: Toggle SALES, SALES_INDEX, QTY_INDEX with same fixture.
results.assertion: Forecast line is absent for non-QTY metrics (critical SSPLAN-623 behavior).
results.evidence: The requested QTY-only forecast behavior is not implemented. `SalesIndexChart` explicitly says only `Sales index` has real data and renders `Qty index`, `Qty`, and `Sales` as unavailable (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/SalesIndexChart.tsx:19-23,82-83,116-123,153-158).
results.failure_reason: Weekly chart does not implement QTY-only forecast behavior

results.assertion: Week labels are deterministically ordered and duplicate handling follows transform rule.
results.evidence: `transformWeeklyTrendRows` keeps the latest fiscal year and sorts ascending by `sywNumber` (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297), but it does not dedupe duplicate week keys, so ordering is deterministic while identity handling is incomplete.

results.steps: Validate COUNTRY/HFB/PA request bodies and filters.
results.assertion: Metric key, level, and filters exactly match expected contract per level.
results.evidence: The source only exposes HFB- and PA-level `WEEKLY_SALES_TREND` requests (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297); the country-level `useSalesByWeek` / `fetchSalesByWeek` contract named in the plan is not present in this project.
results.failure_reason: Weekly request contract missing country/useSalesByWeek implementation

results.steps: Compare FE required keys vs backend response schema fixtures.
results.assertion: Missing/renamed forecast/index fields produce explicit drift failure with key-level diff.
results.evidence: There is no schema drift guard, and the FE types do not model the forecast/index field set described by the plan; only quantity forecast is typed and `forecast` is dropped to `null` during transform (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297).
